source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 16. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: His mother Aminah, his father Abdullah, and the grandfather who named him

learn.en: The Prophet's ﷺ mother was Aminah bint Wahb, from the noble Quraysh tribe.
learn.title: His mother

learn.en: His father was Abdullah. He fell sick on a trade journey and died in Yathrib (Madinah) at 25, before his son was born.
learn.title: His father

learn.en: His grandfather Abdul-Muttalib named him Muhammad, hoping he would be praised by everyone in the world.
learn.title: His name

learn.en: “There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah an excellent example.” (Qur'an 33:21)
learn.title: Our best example

quiz.en: What was the Prophet's ﷺ mother's name?
True or false? The Prophet's ﷺ father died before he was born.
True or false? The Prophet's ﷺ family belonged to the Quraysh tribe.

think.q: Do you know the meaning of your own name, and who chose it for you?
think.a: Ask Mum and Dad! Every name has a story.

parents.summary: The Prophet's ﷺ mother Aminah, his father Abdullah (who died before his birth), and grandfather Abdul-Muttalib who named him Muhammad.
parents.tip: Tell your child the story of how their own name was chosen.
